TITLE: GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty ($5M hack), Xbox Helix & Jensen's comeback? #shorts
---
GTA 6: the hacker behind the 2022 leak pleaded guilty; Rockstar said the hack cost it $5 million.
Xbox: Project Helix is "a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC", not a PC that plays console games.
Nvidia: Jensen Huang is reportedly eyeing a return as CEO, as over 175,000 people sign a petition to bring him back.
📰 Sources: GamesRadar+ https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-hacker-who-reportedly-cost-rockstar-usd5-million-pleads-guilty-to-everything/ · VGC https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/xbox-says-project-helix-is-a-console-that-can-play-pc-games-not-a-pc-that-can-play-console-games/ · PC Gamer https://www.pcgamer.com/software/ai/jensen-huang-reportedly-eyeing-up-return-to-nvidia-as-friendly-tech-execs-form-war-room-to-fight-for-him-and-over-175-000-people-sign-bringjensenback-petition/
